prompt.subject: A vibrant, panoramic celebration of rich Tamil heritage, arts, and traditional craftsmanship set within the sunlit stone corridor of a Dravidian temple complex.

focal_elements.details: In an expressive Araimandi posture, wearing an authentic maroon and temple-gold Kanchipuram silk dance costume, adorned with traditional temple jewelry, salangai (ghungroos), and intricate maruthani (henna) patterns on hands.
Carefully chiseling a lost-wax bronze idol of Nataraja with fine hand tools, accompanied by miniature Thanjavur art panels with embossed gold foil and semi-precious stones.
A dynamic young performer mid-spin with a bamboo staff (Silambam), showcasing speed, discipline, and traditional valor.
Seated artists playing the Nadaswaram, Thavil, and Saraswati Veena, capturing the essence of classical rhythm and melody.

background_and_setting.architecture: Intricately carved granite pillars featuring Yali sculptures, towering multi-tiered Gopuram visible in the soft-focus distance, and polished stone flooring.
background_and_setting.cultural_decor: Hand-drawn rice flour Kolam (Rangoli) on the entrance floor, brass Vilakku (lamps) casting a steady flame, fresh marigold and jasmine garlands, and green plantain stalks framing the pavilion.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Golden hour sunlight streaming through stone pillars, creating soft volumetric light rays mixed with the warm amber glow of oil lamps.
lighting_and_atmosphere.ambiance: Majestic, reverent, celebratory, vibrant, deep cultural pride, cinematic depth of field.

technical_parameters.style: Ultra-detailed realistic digital painting with photographic lighting fidelity
technical_parameters.color_palette: Deep crimson, turmeric yellow, bronze gold, peacock blue, and weathered granite gray
technical_parameters.negative_prompt: blurry, modern attire, low resolution, distorted hands, extra limbs, cartoonish, western architecture, flat lighting
